subject: POS terminal unable to connect to WiFi network
description: The POS terminal in the kitchen area is unable to connect to the WiFi network. The device shows "No Network Available" error and cannot authenticate with the NetLink NL-3000 router. This is impacting order management at the store. I have restarted the device once but the issue persists. The router appears to be functioning normally as other devices in the store are connected without issues.
